verdict.rationale: PayPal documents REST APIs that mirror many merchant dashboard functions. Disputes have both the Resolution Center UI and a Disputes API. Subscriptions can be managed on the dashboard or by API, and invoicing, refunds, payouts and webhooks are covered by APIs, OpenAPI specs and an agent-toolkit inventory. However, nothing states full UI/API parity, and several UI features have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, API coverage for consumer UI features (Savings, Pay in 4, money pooling, debit card) and no-code Payment Links, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools.
